messages:
maria: Kicking off canary for release-2026.03.20 in the 11:00 PT change window.

deploybot: Canary deployment started: prod-canary-1 -> reranker-service@v2.3.0 (canary_id=cb-4821)

alex: Noticed p95 spike on rerank around 11:03 — from ~180ms -> 450ms on prod-canary-1. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/re-rank/…

devon: Confirming, traces show increased attention-kernel time on model v2.3.0. Might be quantized kernel fallback. pinging @jamie for runbook.

jamie: Linking backout runbook + quick steps: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/backout-reranker
jamie:
```
# Quick backout steps (canary)
1) deployctl status canary cb-4821
2) deployctl stop canary cb-4821 --graceful
3) deployctl pin service reranker --version v2.2.1 --env prod
4) wait for traffic shift to pinned version
5) run smoke tests: make smoke-reranker
```

maria: @deploybot can you start step 3 (pin to v2.2.1) and report progress? :pray:

deploybot: Command received: pin reranker -> v2.2.1. Starting rollout to prod pool. (task_id=task-7709)

devon: executing smoke now. If latency doesn't drop under 250ms in 3m we escalate to oncall.

deploybot: Rollout progress: 3/6 nodes rolled back to v2.2.1. No errors reported.

alex: latency p95 dropping to ~210ms on rolled nodes. Good sign. :thumbsup: 

jamie: leaving note in release notes: added rollback reason 'regression: p95 latency increase'. Also pinning decision in changelog links.

maria: OK keep monitoring. If any 500s or error-rate increase >0.5% we fully abort and open incident channel.

sarah: copied thread to #incidents for visibility. (link: https://slack.redwood/archives/INC123)

deploybot: Rollout complete: all prod nodes now on reranker@v2.2.1. task_id=task-7709 finished. Canary cb-4821 marked failed.

alex: thanks, will schedule follow-up RC to re-run quantization bench. Closing thread after postmortem update.
